label: Order Events
description: Orders as events: they arrive when they arrive, sometimes twice, never as a tidy file.

lesson.intent: The Order Events source; Day 2 sends one twice.

labVersion: The Order Events source; Day 2 sends one twice.
governanceNote: An event is a fact that something happened; the flow decides what to do about it, including nothing.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Order Record
description: One row per order, materialized from its events, carrying its current state.

lesson.intent: The Orders table, add-or-replace by orderId, updated by each shipment event.

labVersion: The Orders table, add-or-replace by orderId, updated by each shipment event.
accessNeeded: Write access to the orders table
soloRebuildPath: Later replay the events to rebuild it
governanceNote: The record is derived from events; rerunning the events must rebuild the same record.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Inventory Ledger
description: Stock as a running balance: receipts, reservations and compensations as rows with deltas.

lesson.intent: The Inventory Ledger table; on hand and committed are sums over it.

labVersion: The Inventory Ledger table; on hand and committed are sums over it.
soloRebuildPath: Record every receipt and reservation as a row
Sum them for on hand and committed
governanceNote: A snapshot lies the moment two orders arrive together; a ledger cannot.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Availability Check
description: On hand minus committed, from the ledger, at the moment the order lands.

lesson.intent: The sums and the available Transform in the Order placed flow.

labVersion: The sums and the available Transform in the Order placed flow.
governanceNote: Available means on hand MINUS committed; the naive check sells the last unit twice.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Reserve Decision
description: Enough available: reserve it in the ledger. Not enough: backorder.

lesson.intent: The Condition qty <= available in the Order placed flow.

labVersion: The Condition qty <= available in the Order placed flow.
governanceNote: A reservation is a ledger row the next order sees; it is what makes the decision safe.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Backorder Path
description: The order that waits: logged with what was available, and the customer told by a person.

lesson.intent: The NO lane: Backorders store and the message to the Customer Service Rep.

labVersion: The NO lane: Backorders store and the message to the Customer Service Rep.
soloRebuildPath: Tell the customer with a promise date
governanceNote: A wait nobody explains is a cancellation.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Reorder Points
description: Per SKU: the available position at which to reorder, and how much.

lesson.intent: The Reorder Points table, owned by the Inventory Planner.

labVersion: The Reorder Points table, owned by the Inventory Planner.
soloRebuildPath: Set a point and a quantity per SKU
Later tune them from demand history
governanceNote: The points are the planner's; the flow only compares and signals.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Replenishment Trigger
description: A reservation that takes the position to the point or below signals a purchase.

lesson.intent: The position Transform and Condition in the reserve lane.

labVersion: The position Transform and Condition in the reserve lane.
soloRebuildPath: Compute the position after the reservation
governanceNote: Only a reservation moves the position; a backorder never triggers a reorder.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: State Machine
description: The legal transitions: which event may follow which state. Delivered cannot follow packed.

lesson.intent: The State Machine table, keyed by from and to.

labVersion: The State Machine table, keyed by from and to.
governanceNote: Illegal moves are refused, not corrected; someone sent a bad event and should hear about it.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Pick, Pack, Ship
description: Each shipment event moves its order to the next state - if the state machine allows it.

lesson.intent: The Shipment events flow: lookup, transition check, state update.

labVersion: The Shipment events flow: lookup, transition check, state update.
governanceNote: The order's row is updated in place; its history is the events.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Carrier Handoff
description: The boundary crossing: shipped, with a tracking id captured on the order.

lesson.intent: The shipped event carrying its tracking id into the Orders row.

labVersion: The shipped event carrying its tracking id into the Orders row.
governanceNote: Once it crosses to the carrier, the flow can only listen.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Shipment Events
description: Mid-flight events from pickers, packers and carriers: delays, damage, delivery.

lesson.intent: The Shipment Events source; Day 3 reports damage.

labVersion: The Shipment Events source; Day 3 reports damage.
soloRebuildPath: Notice ones that arrive out of order
governanceNote: Events can arrive out of order; the state machine is what makes that safe.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Compensation Policy
description: For each failure event: what to undo, in what order, and who tells the customer.
governanceNote: Undo means a new ledger row, never a deleted one.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Exception Compensation
description: Executing the policy: reserve a replacement, mark the order compensated, log it, tell the customer.

lesson.intent: The damaged lane in the Shipment events flow.

labVersion: The damaged lane in the Shipment events flow.
governanceNote: A failure that ends an order silently is worse than the failure.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Delivery Confirmation
description: The closing event captured on the order: delivered, with when.

lesson.intent: The delivered state on the Orders row.

labVersion: The delivered state on the Orders row.
governanceNote: Delivered is the only state a customer cares about; it is also the only one that needs proof.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Fulfillment Digest
description: The 6:00 PM digest: delivered, backordered, compensated, reorders.

lesson.intent: Composed by the 6:00 PM digest flow and sent to Ops DL.

labVersion: Composed by the 6:00 PM digest flow and sent to Ops DL.
governanceNote: The digest counts what the events did, not what someone remembers.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Order Archive
description: Every digest, kept; what actually sold tunes the reorder points.
governanceNote: Demand history is how the planner learns where the points should sit.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Depot (2026-09-29).

label: Order Run Operations
description: Event-driven automation is never finished: events repeat, arrive out of order, and report failures mid-flight. The flow handles each without a person, and tells one when it cannot.

lesson.intent: Handle repeats, illegal events and failures without a person.

labVersion: Built by you on Days 2 and 3: repeats rejected, illegal moves refused, damage compensated.
soloRebuildPath: Refuse what the state cannot accept
governanceNote: The rejected-events table is the operator's inbox.
